description: Work mode: SessionStart applies the default_mode plugin option (/config) to a project that has no mode set by hand; UserPromptSubmit adds a short fast-mode reminder (no tests, no Pint, no self-check, no docs lookups, no browser checks, no review agents; visual work live in Chrome — screen first, then the rest; record deferred checks) to every prompt when the project's .claude/work-mode.local.md says mode: fast. Silent in full mode. Pure bash, always exits 0.
